name: Lapis Chinese
description: Mandarin Chinese adaptation of the Lapis Anki note type, with Pinyin and Simplified and Traditional character support.
features: Ready-to-import APKG with an example deck
Pinyin support with tone-aware styling
Persistent Simplified and Traditional character conversion
Vocabulary, sentence, audio, click, and combined card modes

name: Danmei 5k
description: Anki deck of the 5000 most common words in danmei novels, for learners who want to read them in Chinese.
features: Words from a frequency list built from about 2000 danmei novels, without character names
An i+1 example sentence from the novels on every card
CC-CEDICT definitions, with missing words and senses written in the same style
TTS audio for words and sentences, on the Lapis Chinese note type

items.name: hydcd-yomitan
items.description: 漢語大詞典 七訂 with normalized Pinyin readings for matching and tone coloring in Yomitan and Lapis, collapsible examples, and packaged images.

items.name: xhdcd-yomitan
items.description: 现代汉语大词典 as a text-only dictionary with Pinyin readings, examples, variant headwords, and internal term links.

items.name: chengyu-yomitan
items.description: 汉语成语源流大辞典 and 新华成语大词典 with HYDCD-style formatting, collapsible examples, and Simplified and Traditional lookup.

items.name: chinese-wikipedia-dictionary
items.description: 2.1M Chinese Wikipedia titles and redirects with short Simplified Chinese definitions from each article's lead, for names, places, works, and terms general dictionaries miss. Rebuilt monthly.

items.name: moegirl-yomitan
items.description: Moegirlpedia (萌娘百科) lead summaries as a term dictionary for anime, games, and internet culture. Rebuilt weekly.

items.name: bilibili-slang-dictionary
items.description: Chinese–English dictionary of slang, memes, fandom, and gaming terms from Bilibili comments, plus web novel and danmei vocabulary. Also available as MDict.

items.name: genshin-yomitan
items.description: Genshin Impact (原神) names and terms built from the game's own data: characters, places, enemies, items, talents, quests, and more, with Chinese or English definitions.

items.name: yomitan-frequency-dicts
items.description: Chinese word frequency dictionaries from 2.29B Bilibili comments and 2,047 danmei novels, segmented with HanLP.

items.name: shiberu-yomitan
items.description: Shiberu Korean word frequency list (80,000 words) as a Yomitan frequency dictionary.

name: CalibreAnalyzer
description: Calibre plugin for analyzing Chinese books by character or word, with HSK coverage, optional Anki comparison, and bundled offline word segmentation runtimes.
features: Character and word frequency analysis for Chinese books
HSK coverage breakdowns and word-length statistics
Optional Anki comparison for known words or characters
Auto-versioned GitHub releases on every push to main

name: hanstat
description: Character and word statistics for Chinese EPUB and TXT files, with exact hanzi counts and LTP, CKIP, or jieba word segmentation. Windows GUI and CLI.
features: Exact Han character counts across every Unicode ideograph block, with EPUB TOC, ruby, and hidden text excluded
Script-aware segmentation: LTP for Simplified, CKIP for Traditional, or jieba offline
Automatic name discovery to keep character names whole in word counts
Coverage, per-section breakdowns, CSV/JSON export, and known-word coverage from Anki

name: anki-ui-fonts
description: Anki add-on for separate UI and browser fonts, sizes, and regional CJK rendering. Available on AnkiWeb as 1031646718.
features: Separate Latin and CJK fonts and sizes for the interface and browser entries
Automatic regional CJK font selection (Noto Sans, then Microsoft UI fonts)
Rendering locale for zh-Hans, zh-Hant-TW, zh-Hant-HK, ja, and ko
Live preview with Apply, Cancel, and Restore Defaults

name: UpdateNotifier
description: Windows tray app that notifies you about new GitHub releases, pre-releases, or commits.
features: Watch stable releases, all releases, or commits on a branch per repository
Native Windows notifications that open the release or compare page
Reuses an existing GitHub login (Credential Manager, env var, gh, or Git)
Single ~3 MB executable with no runtime dependencies
